Title: SQL Server on Virtual Machines: Machine Learning with Microsoft R Open 4.0.2 now available
Services: SQL Server on Azure Virtual Machines

Body.Content: In September 2020, Microsoft R Open users received the latest update for Microsoft R Open 4.0.2. Our data scientist communities have relied on Microsoft R Open the past five years to build models to solve vast and diverse problems including, for example, COVID-19 vaccine drug trials, preferred personalization engines in retail settings, supply chain processing, and remote monitoring of oil rigs in the ocean. The opportunities are endless with machine learning to solve real world problems.
